tools.name: get_account_status
tools.title: Get account status
tools.description: Return the signed-in AirMileX user's remaining credits, selected maps provider, and whether their Airtable and maps keys are configured.

tools.name: list_calculation_logs
tools.title: List mileage jobs
tools.description: List the signed-in user's recent mileage calculation jobs, newest first, with the Airtable base and table, record count, and provider used.

limit.description: How many jobs to return (1-100, default 20).

tools.name: list_saved_mappings
tools.title: List saved column mappings
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved Airtable column mappings (start address, end address, and distance output column per table).
